interpretation.finding: HTTP responses were locally fresh, but a large majority of evaluated hard-arb sets carried exchange snapshot timestamps that were too old or mutually skewed. Local receive freshness alone would therefore have admitted mixed/stale multi-leg state.
interpretation.threshold_decision: Do not lower the 0.5 bp hard-arb economic floor to create activity. The current binding defect is synchronized exchange-state freshness, not the edge floor.
next_required_experiment: prefer event-driven per-token book state with exchange timestamp continuity over mixed REST snapshots
require all legs simultaneously inside receive-age and exchange-age/skew bounds
retain multi-level depth and authoritative fee schedules
revalidate sequentially before each paper leg and unwind partial acquisition on failure
only then evaluate recurrence and cost-stressed fill-conditioned PnL
